description: AGSC-06-34 with AGSC-06-07: the card is emitted only when the node declares both a2a-card and a responder surface. Three nodes: a2a-card declared and no responder (no card is emitted, and the declaration is a card without an endpoint, reported as AGSC-E210); a responder declared and no a2a-card (no card, no finding); neither (no card, no finding). A read-only local MCP tool server declares no responder and makes no node eligible. Derived by hand from the rule.
